overview.title: Application engineering. Self-hosted operations.
overview.description: The development layer defines and compiles business modules. Lite is a single-project Bun and PGlite runtime; the full platform manages multiple projects on Pigsty. These are not three interchangeable editions.
overview.subtitle: Build with explicit contracts. Choose hosting for the workload.
cards: Business modules, static wiring, schemas and generated clients
Business policy and object-level authorization stay application-owned
Bun + PGlite / one project per process
No multi-project control plane or Studio
Management API, Web Console, Admin CLI
overview.note: The development layer is not a hosting edition; this overview does not imply deployment parity.

build-runtime.title: From application declarations to execution
build-runtime.description: Application declarations pass through the compiler to generated artifacts. At runtime the Elysia host consumes compiled modules and invokes application-owned services. The host still installs Elysia; business modules need not import native Elysia types.
build-runtime.subtitle: Static wiring and HTTP hosting have separate responsibilities.
build-runtime.note: Compilation is not proof of business correctness or support for arbitrary HTTP frameworks.

project-storage.title: One storage backend per project
project-storage.description: Storage API authorization precedes routing by trusted projectRef. Unbound projects retain platform storage; projects A and B use independent S3 endpoint, credential, physical bucket and prefix bindings. Failed bindings never fall back to other storage.
project-storage.subtitle: Project isolation, not bucket-level source selection or automatic failover.
project-storage.note: A configured backend failure is an error — never a fallback to platform storage.

overview.title: 应用工程底座，自托管运行平台
overview.description: 开发层负责业务模块的声明与编译。Lite 是基于 Bun 和 PGlite 的单项目运行时；完整平台在 Pigsty 上管理多个项目。它们不是三个可以直接互换的版本。
overview.subtitle: 以明确契约组织开发，按工作负载选择运行形态。
overview.lane: 运行形态 / 各自具有不同的运维边界
cards: 业务模块、静态装配、Schema 与生成的客户端
业务规则与对象级授权仍由应用负责
Bun + PGlite / 每个进程一个项目
不提供多项目控制面或 Studio
共享基础设施，由平台运维者管理
overview.note: 开发层不是一种托管版本；本图不表示不同运行形态已具备相同的部署能力。

build-runtime.title: 从应用声明到业务执行
build-runtime.description: 应用声明经过编译器生成产物。运行时，Elysia 宿主消费编译后的模块并调用应用拥有的服务。宿主仍需安装 Elysia，业务模块无需导入原生 Elysia 类型。
build-runtime.subtitle: 静态装配与 HTTP 托管各自承担明确职责。
cards: 运行时使用编译后的模块
build-runtime.note: 编译通过不等于业务正确，也不代表已支持任意 HTTP 框架。

project-storage.title: 每个项目绑定一个存储后端
project-storage.description: Storage API 完成授权后按可信 projectRef 路由。未绑定项目保留平台存储，项目 A 和 B 分别使用具有独立 endpoint、凭据、物理桶和前缀的 S3 绑定。绑定故障不会回退到其他存储。
project-storage.subtitle: 实现项目隔离，而非桶级来源选择或自动故障切换。
cards: 每次操作使用不可变客户端
保留原有桶与对象路径布局
project-storage.note: 已绑定后端发生故障时返回错误，不会回退到平台存储。
